void websocket_server_cancel_service (websocket_server_t * server)

Wake the WebSocket server event loop immediately. Thread-safe. Wakes lws_service() from its timeout wait, allowing the event loop to check the running flag without waiting for the full service timeout (50ms).

Parameters

server Server instance (must have a valid context)

870                                                                    {
871   if (!server || !server->context) {
872     return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid server");
873   }
874
875   log_info("WebSocket server starting event loop on port %d", server->port);
876
877   // Run libwebsockets event loop
878   uint64_t last_service_ns = 0;
879   int service_call_count = 0;
880   while (atomic_load_bool(&server->running)) {
881     // Service libwebsockets with 16ms timeout to match 60 FPS frame rate.
882     // This provides frequent event processing (~60 callback invocations per second) so that
883     // WebSocket frames queued by the render loop are sent promptly, matching TCP performance.
884     // All client connections share this single server context, so a single lws_service() call
885     // services fragments and events for all clients simultaneously.
886     uint64_t service_start_ns = time_get_ns();
887     if (last_service_ns && service_start_ns - last_service_ns > 30 * US_PER_MS_INT) {
888       // > 30ms gap between service calls
889       double gap_ms = (double)(service_start_ns - last_service_ns) / 1e6;
890       log_debug_every(US_PER_SEC_INT, "[LWS_SERVICE_GAP] %.1fms gap between lws_service calls", gap_ms);
891     }
892     service_call_count++;
893     log_debug_every(500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "[LWS_SERVICE] Call #%d, context=%s", service_call_count,
894                     NAMED_DESCRIBE(server->context, "websocket_server"));
895     int result = lws_service(server->context, 1);
896     if (result < 0) {
897       log_error("libwebsockets service error: %d", result);
898       break;
899     }
900   }
901
902   log_info(
903       "WebSocket server event loop exited (context will be destroyed by main thread after handler threads complete)");
904   return ASCIICHAT_OK;
905 }
